mapper.sql: id, kind, goods_id, `day`, tier, score, suggestion, reasons, status, ref_id, add_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_promo_candidate (kind, goods_id, `day`, tier, score, suggestion, reasons, status, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{kind}, #{goodsId}, #{day}, #{tier}, coalesce(#{score}, 0.00), #{suggestion}, #{reasons}, coalesce(#{status}, 'proposed'), now(), now(), 0) on duplicate key update tier = if(status = 'proposed', values(tier), tier), score = if(status = 'proposed', values(score), score), suggestion = if(status = 'proposed', values(suggestion), suggestion), reasons = if(status = 'proposed', values(reasons), reasons), update_time = if(status = 'proposed', now(), update_time)
mapper.select: select from litemall_promo_candidate where kind = #{kind} and `day` = #{day} and deleted = 0 and status = #{status} order by score desc, id asc
select max(`day`) from litemall_promo_candidate where kind = #{kind} and deleted = 0
select from litemall_promo_candidate where kind = #{kind} and goods_id = #{goodsId} and `day` = #{day} and deleted = 0
select from litemall_promo_candidate where kind = #{kind} and goods_id = #{goodsId} and deleted = 0 order by `day` desc limit 1
mapper.update: update litemall_promo_candidate set status = #{status}, ref_id = coalesce(#{refId}, ref_id), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{expect} and deleted = 0
